title: ticfac run --cloud accepts --config: carry the named config in the factory submission
description: ticfac run --cloud refuses --config because the factory's submission record has no field for it, so a cloud run can choose a named config only through the epic's config:<name> label. Carry it in the submission (contract field), the orchestrator applies it with the same precedence as a local run (flag > label > default).
